entry.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is conducting a broad investigation into Polymarket covering staged trades and fake winning bets, Bloomberg reported Friday, advancing the agency’s scrutiny beyond the platform’s prior influencer scheme.

entry.title: DraftKings Launches Proprietary Prediction Markets Exchange With $3.4B Annualized Consumer Volume
entry.summary: DraftKings has launched DKeX, a proprietary prediction markets exchange, reporting $3.4 billion in annualized consumer volume as it enters a field increasingly crowded by Kalshi, Polymarket, Meta Arena, and Robinhood.

entry.title: OKX and Coinbase Race to Sign Up Binance's Displaced EU Users Before MiCA Deadline
entry.summary: OKX is offering EEA users deposit bonuses of up to 8% and Coinbase has launched a parallel transfer bonus for subscribers in eight European markets, as both licensed exchanges compete to capture users displaced by Binance's July 1 MiCA wind-down.

entry.title: BNY Adds USDC to Institutional Custody Platform in Expanded Circle Partnership
entry.summary: BNY, the world's largest custodian bank with $59.4 trillion in assets under custody, has made USDC the first stablecoin on its Digital Asset Custody platform, enabling institutional clients to store, transfer, mint, and redeem Circle's dollar-pegged token alongside traditional assets.

entry.title: BlackRock Adds Ethena's Synthetic Dollar to Its $20T Aladdin Risk Management Platform
entry.summary: The world's largest asset manager will list the USDe synthetic dollar as an approved asset on its institutional risk platform, while its BUIDL fund becomes the primary backing for Ethena's whitelabel stablecoins.

entry.title: Strategy Authorizes up to $1.25B of Bitcoin Sales as Saylor Formalizes Capital Pivot

entry.title: AMLBot Puts Polymarket Phishing Toll at $3.1M Across 11 Wallets, Funds Traced to Ethereum
entry.summary: Blockchain intelligence firm AMLBot has confirmed the Polymarket supply-chain attack total at approximately $3.1 million in PUSD across 11 user wallets, with funds bridged from Polygon to Ethereum and converted to ETH. Polymarket has pledged full refunds but has not named the compromised vendor.

entry.title: Aave Confirms Aavenomics 3.0 Is Live With Buybacks and DAO Spending Cut
entry.summary: Aave confirmed Saturday that Aavenomics 3.0 is now active, with automated AAVE token buybacks running and DAO operational spending reduced, completing a governance roadmap the protocol has built toward since mid-2024.

entry.title: Strategy's Enterprise mNAV Drops Below 1 for the First Time
entry.summary: Strategy's enterprise market-to-NAV ratio crossed below 1 on Thursday for the first time, putting the combined weight of its debt, preferred stock, and equity above the value of its 847,363-bitcoin treasury and closing the equity-accretion channel that powered its buying spree.

entry.title: Aave Advances Automated AAVE Buyback Overhaul With Aavenomics 3.0
entry.summary: Aave founder Stani Kulechov previewed Aavenomics 3.0 on X Thursday, an automated on-chain buyback mechanism that would route all protocol and GHO revenue to AAVE holders by default, replacing the existing discretionary committee-directed program.

entry.title: MoneyGram CEO on rolling out MGUSD to its 60 million users, globally
entry.summary: MoneyGram has been quietly building on blockchain for over five years. Now, with its own stablecoin (MGUSD), a Kraken partnership, a validator seat on the Tempo network, and $2B+ in stablecoin settlements already running — the pace is accelerating.

entry.summary: Kraken's xStocks platform is opening non-binding interest registration for the Bending Spoons IPO to eligible customers in the EEA and select global markets, the tokenized equities infrastructure's second pre-IPO offering after a troubled SpaceX debut.

entry.title: Polymarket Confirms $3 Million Loss From Third-Party Front-End Supply-Chain Breach
entry.summary: Polymarket confirmed hackers drained approximately $3 million through a compromised third-party vendor that injected malicious code into the platform's website, and pledged full refunds to fewer than 15 affected accounts.

entry.title: Zuckerberg Urges Meta to Explore Polymarket and Kalshi Partnerships
entry.summary: Mark Zuckerberg has pushed Meta's leadership to explore partnerships with Polymarket and Kalshi, per a new New York Times report, days after a separate report revealed Meta is building its own prediction-market app called Arena.

entry.summary: Chainlink and a multinational consortium of more than 50 banks across 16 countries launched Project Pangea at Point Zero Forum in Zurich, targeting real-time atomic settlement for the $9.6 trillion-a-day global foreign exchange market via Chainlink rails, Swift messaging, and regulated EUR and KRW

entry.summary: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin went live in Japan on Tuesday after receiving approval from Japan's Financial Services Agency, becoming the first foreign-issued stablecoin classified under Japan's revised Payment Services Act.

entry.title: 17 Democratic Senators Seek to Bar CFTC From Funding Prediction-Market State Lawsuits

entry.title: Why Wall Street's Biggest Traders Are Abandoning Crypto for Prediction Markets | Alex Momot
entry.summary: Prediction markets are entering a new phase — and the biggest market makers in the world are taking notice. Alex Momot, Co-founder of Peanut Trade, joins Camila Russo to break down the mechanics, the opportunity, and the risks behind this fast-moving space.

entry.summary: Securitize, the tokenization platform behind BlackRock's BUIDL fund, is set to begin trading on the NYSE on July 2 under the ticker SECZ after a SPAC merger with Cantor Equity Partners II that raised over $400 million, including an oversubscribed $225M PIPE.

entry.summary: StablecoinX Inc. (Nasdaq: USDE) began trading Friday after closing its SPAC merger with TLGY Acquisition Corp., becoming the first publicly listed company holding approximately 3.03 billion ENA tokens and building infrastructure for the Ethena ecosystem.

entry.summary: Ondo Finance has enabled around-the-clock minting and redemption for tokenized US stocks and ETFs on Ethereum and BNB Chain, removing the weekday-only constraint that had tied position creation and cancellation to US market hours.

entry.summary: Sophon is decommissioning its zkSync-based Layer 2 chain and pivoting to Soph+, a consumer product studio building exclusively on Base. entry.summary: Synthetix governance has moved to retire sUSD entirely under SIP-423, introduced June 12. entry.title: Morgan Stanley Files Amended S-1s for Spot Solana and Ethereum Trusts
entry.summary: Morgan Stanley's amended S-1 filings for its spot Solana and spot Ethereum trusts name BNY Mellon and Coinbase Custody as joint custodians, set a 0.14% sponsor fee, and reserve the tickers MSOL and MSSE on NYSE Arca. Both products include staking provisions.

entry.title: Jaredfromsubway.eth, Ethereum's Most Active Sandwich Bot, Drained for $7.5M Over the Weekend
entry.summary: An attacker drained more than $7.5 million from jaredfromsubway.eth, the Ethereum address tied to roughly 70% of sandwich attacks on the network, after a counter-MEV honeypot fed it 66 fake token contracts over several weeks. Blockaid disclosed the exploit Saturday.

entry.title: Dormant Wallet Tied to HashFlare Fraud Moves 10,600 ETH Worth $18.5M
entry.summary: An Ethereum address tied to the HashFlare cloud-mining Ponzi moved 10,600 ETH worth about $18.5 million on Monday morning after sitting idle for roughly three and a half years.
